subject: Scheduling: Intake Sync & Procurement Timeline for HelixCorp Pilot
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Mar 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling: Intake Sync & Procurement Timeline for HelixCorp Pilot

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the intro call last week. HelixCorp's pilot sounds like a great fit for Redwood. I want to get a short intake/discovery on the calendar to align stakeholders (technical lead, procurement, and security) and lock in a procurement timeline so we can scope pricing and delivery.

Proposed structure: 30 minutes (AE + customer champion + engineering lead) for discovery, followed by an optional 30-minute deep-dive with our SE (Marissa) if the eng team wants to go through architecture and network requirements.

Can you confirm the right engineering and procurement contacts? You mentioned John Park as the engineering lead — is procurement@helixcorp.com the right procurement alias?

Available slots this week: Wed 3/23 10:00–11:00 PDT, Thu 3/24 14:00–15:00 PDT, Fri 3/25 09:00–09:45 PDT. If none of those work, here's a 30-min Calendly with more options: https://calendly.com/redwood/helixcorp-intake-30

Attached: quick demo deck to give your procurement and security teams a high-level view (redwood-demo-deck-v3.pdf).

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.

— Markus
Markus Klein | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0187
[Attachment: redwood-demo-deck-v3.pdf]

Subject: Re: Scheduling: Intake Sync & Procurement Timeline for HelixCorp Pilot

Markus —

Thanks for the summary and the deck, looks good at a glance. John is available for an initial 30-minute discovery — and procurement (procurement@helixcorp.com) should join the same call so we can start timeline conversations. Rishi, Marissa — appreciate you joining.

Of the slots you suggested, Wed 3/23 10:00 PDT works for John and me, but quick heads up: my VP asked me to include one agenda item on data residency and logging. Rishi, could you drop a 1–2 line note on what HelixCorp should expect from Redwood for the first-pass security deliverables (SOC2, audit logs, data retention)?

If anything changes I’ll flag it, otherwise please send the invite.

Best,
Claire

Claire —

Quick note ahead of the call: for the intake we typically provide a SOC 2 summary, high-level audit-log capabilities (what’s captured, retention window options), and network egress guidance. I’ll bring a short checklist to the call and can follow up with formal evidence after initial scoping.

If you have specific compliance controls your VP cares about, send them my way and I’ll call them out directly.

— Rishi

Thanks, Claire — I’ll send an invite for Wed 3/23 10:00 PDT. Agenda (30 min):
- 00–05: Introductions & pilot goals (Markus / Claire)
- 05–15: High-level technical constraints & success metrics (John / Marissa)
- 15–25: Procurement timeline and initial pricing shape (procurement rep / Markus)
- 25–30: Next steps & action items (all)

Marissa — if it’s helpful, attaching a short pre-call questionnaire you can share with John so we have network/config details before the technical deep-dive.

Calendly invite sent: https://calendly.com/redwood/helixcorp-intake-30 (I’ll convert to a calendar invite once Claire confirms).

— Markus

I added a few quick asks in the attached pre-call questionnaire — if John can fill out the network details (VPC peering/egress ranges, expected sequence length / token rates, and whether an on-prem connector is required) that will let me prepare a short architecture sketch to share immediately after the call.

See you Wednesday —
